item.title: Self-Hosted Nix Deployment Systems: NixOps vs Colmena vs deploy-rs
item.description: Managing infrastructure across multiple servers requires reliable deployment tooling that handles dependency resolution, rollback capabilities, and reproducible builds. The Nix ecosystem offers three mature deployment systems that take different approaches to the same problem: provisioning and managing NixOS configurations on remote machines. This guide compares NixOps, Colmena, and deploy-rs to help you choose the right tool for your infrastructure needs.

item.title: Self-Hosted Dev Environment Managers 2026: Devbox vs Nix vs Dev Containers
item.description: Inconsistent development environments cause the classic “works on my machine” problem. Every developer has different tool versions, library paths, and system dependencies. Dev environment managers solve this by codifying your development setup so anyone can recreate it with a single command. This guide compares three approaches: Devbox, Nix, and Dev Containers.

item.title: Attic vs Harmonia vs niks3: Best Self-Hosted Nix Binary Cache 2026
item.description: If you are using the Nix package manager across multiple machines, a local binary cache eliminates redundant builds and dramatically speeds up deployments. Instead of every machine compiling the same package from source, you build once, push to your cache server, and all other machines download the pre-built binary.
